title: Haaye sughra bathaa kya likhoon
body:
Haaye sughra bathaa kya likhoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula maqtal mein sar ko jhukaaye
Laash-e-Akbar pey tanhaa khadey hai
Dheemey dheemey tapaktey hai aansoo
Haaye Sughra ka khath parh rahey hain
